ValidationRule.description: Restrict the Sales Agreement to move it from Approved to Draft.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c) , ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),"Approved"), (ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Draft') || ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Archived')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Agreement can’t be moved from Approved to other stage. Please amend the Sales Agreement to make any changes.
